_about: THE MODERN GENRE'S BUILDINGS (Harry 2026-11-07: "types should be kinds of *building* not kinds of sub-genre (look at how fantasy got done)"; and "we basically don't need to distinguish between cyberpunk and modern now"). The Build menu's Modern types are these buildings, not City / Cyberpunk. A NEW MODERN ROOM IS ONE LINE in `rooms`: its room key (tools/spawn-tuner/build_data.py) and the buildings it belongs in, e.g. "mod-penthouse": ["APT"]. A room may sit in several buildings when it truly belongs to each (the menu's symlinks). A building's rooms list in the tray hub first, then in this file's order; `hub` names the room a dragged-out building is built around (else its first hub-role room, else its largest); `hall` names its corridor, the plan's spine where a fantasy building has its hallway (tools/spawn-tuner/js/buildings.js buildingRoles: any other corridor the building lists is drawn by hand, never laid as a room; modhalls lane 2026-11-07); `lift`: true puts an elevator through every storey of a generated building, beside the stair (buildings.js findLift, core/buildplan.js: the car, the shaft's holes, the landing doors). The catalog keeps its setting codes MOD and CYB (the roles' `set:` fields, the recipe prefixes mod- / cyb-, the look tiers): `replaces` are the codes these buildings stand in for, never shown as types; `legacy` points an old saved building's code (gen.code MOD / CYB, a building generated before 2026-11-07) at the building that re-rolls it. `pack`: on the assets page the whole genre is ONE pack (Harry: one Modern pack, one blurb), its slug, and the old slugs and codes (`was`) a link may still carry (?pack=cyberpunk/cyb-clinic, /assets#pack/modern-city). engine/tools/build_types.py reads this; engine/test/modern_buildings.test.mjs fails when a modern room is in no building, a building has one room, or a code is unknown.
